title: TanStack Start, compressPublicAssets
notes: TanStack Start with Nitro's compressPublicAssets on: the prerendered /about and the client files are also sent compressed. The dynamic page and the API are as in the default entry.
details: TanStack Start with Nitro's compressPublicAssets option on: the build also writes gzip, brotli and zstd copies of the public files of 1 KB or more, the prerendered /about among them, and the server sends the copy a request accepts instead of the file. Nothing else changes, so the dynamic page and the API route are still sent uncompressed. Built into its own folder (.output-compressed-assets). Built with vite build and the Nitro plugin, as the hosting guide says for Node.js; the Nitro node-server output (.output/server/index.mjs) is imported into the measured process, on Bun and Deno as on Node. The server underneath is a pre-release: Nitro 3 is a beta and its h3 a release candidate, the versions the framework's guide installs. The port is passed through NITRO_PORT (0, for a free one) and the host through NITRO_HOST, and the port is read from the line the server prints when it listens. Not a default: /about is prerendered by Nitro's prerender option, because the page TanStack Start's own prerender option writes is not served by this server.
